highlights: Results Update 16th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 8,705 Eicher Motors Ltd Auto 1 Capacity Expansion; Product Refreshes & International Growth Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – INLINE; EBITDA – MISS; PAT – MISS Change in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 4.1%/5.3%; EBITDA: 0.3%/2.5%; PAT: -3.4%/-0.1% Recommendation Rationale • Strong Demand & Capacity Expansion: Royal Enfield delivered its highest-ever quarterly sales of 3,76,722 motorcycles in Q2FY27, registering 15% YoY growth, with domestic volumes increasing 16% to 3,40,847 units.

Despite monthly production increasing by nearly 15% during the year, dealer inventory remained at just 7-8 days, indicating that near-term growth is largely supply-constrained rather than demand-driven.

The upcoming expansion of the platform towards a second product, the S6 Scrambler, provides additional long-term growth optionality, while investments in retail, service infrastructure and customer experience are expected to support the gradual development of the premium electric motorcycle category.
